Score & Grade: 0 Grade:

Observations & Corrective Actions

02: 3717-1-02.4(A)(3) Facility does not have an employee with manager certification in food protection. **One person per facility must have an Manager Level 2 certification in food safety education. Information attached with report.

08: 3717-1-02.2 (C) Food employee(s) did not wash hands when required. **Observed two employees attempt to change gloves and tasks without washing hands first. Corrected, employees washed hands at time of inspection after receiving education. Ensure employees wash hands when required. Hands must always be washed prior to changing gloves to perform a new task.

08: 3717-1-02.2 (D) Food employee(s) not washing hands in approved handwashing sink or automatic handwashing facility. **Observed employee attempt to wash hands in 3 compartment sink. Corrected, employee washed hands in hand washing sink after receiving education. Ensure employees wash hands in hand washing sink to prevent contamination of equipment.

62: 3717-1-06.4(B) Facility not maintained clean. **Observed spilled product build up beneath shelving in back storage area. Clean and increase cleaning frequency to prevent attraction of pests.

62: 3717-1-06.4(A) Physical facilities not maintained in good repair. **Observed base coving on cabinet near donuts partially ripped off. Repair so that area between floor and cabinet can be properly cleaned.

66: 3701-21-25(K)(Repeat) FSO/RFE did not have a person in charge per shift with the person in charge certification in food protection. **Per conversation, facility did not have any employees with food safety training. One person per shift must have a Level 1 certification in food safety education.
